name: nodejs.restore
description: Rollback of nodejs.remove: move the newest backup of /opt/node/NN under /var/backups/node-remove back into place. When /opt/node/NN already exists (the remove refused, so nothing was removed) it changes nothing and succeeds. It refuses when /opt/node/NN is missing and there is no backup for that major.

major.description: The Node.js major to restore, two digits, such as 20.

health_check: The helper confirms /opt/node/NN is back, or was never removed.
